column3: It is the immediate inverse: when Allah misguides, no guide remains, framing the focus's secure guidance.

It closely parallels the inverse condition: Allah's misguidance leaves neither protectors nor a way.

It merely repeats the earlier general statement of divine capability.

Allah misguides whom He wills and guides whom He wills in the context of warning and punishment.

Human choice to remain upright is expressly bounded by Allah's will as Lord of all worlds.
The severe grasp of the Lord directly reinforces the focus's declaration of divine vengeance.
